Resolves #19678

`ButtonBaseNL`'s two configuration tests waited a fixed 500 ms and then queried the configuration panel's `text` field once over the Neural Link. When the panel had not rendered yet, the query returned nothing, which made both tests red together in 3 of 5 hosted samples. A small `findTextField` helper now polls the same query until the field exists, and both tests use it in place of their fixed waits.

Micro-review eligible: test-only. It changes one spec's waiting, not what any test asserts.

Evidence: L2 (a hosted A/B on one runner, interleaved) → L2 required (the AC asks for the A/B). Residual: none. Residual-Owner: #19657 (the rest of the intermittent set).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `:47` and `:75` call `findTextField(app)`, which polls `queryComponent({ntype: 'textfield', labelText: 'text'})` with `expect.poll` and a named message. Neither test has a fixed wait left. |
| AC-2 | [One-runner A/B](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38296398179), in the order every red sample had (`WindowOps`, `WorkerStateMutation`, then the whole file), interleaved ×3. `dev`'s version failed one configuration test in all 3 runs, with both known errors. The fix passed all 6 tests in all 3 runs. |

## Deltas from ticket
None.

## Test Evidence
- [The first A/B](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38295847714) ran the two tests alone. Both versions passed 4 of 4, so it could not discriminate: the red needs the file's place in the shard.
- That place is the same in every sample. The file runs after `WindowOps` and `WorkerStateMutation`, its first test (which waits on the DOM) always passes, and the two configuration tests failed together in 3 of 5.
- The second A/B (AC-2) reproduced the red 3 of 3 with `dev`'s version and 0 of 3 with the fix. A second suspect, the fixture's app-name fallback binding an older session, would not have healed under polling.
- `--list` loads the spec's four tests.
- The PR's own CI does not run this file; the Brain-gated tier runs it on `dev` pushes.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] The next `dev`-push receipts show both tests green; #19657's intermittent tally drops them once they stay green.
